players.product: trapped-ion quantum computers (Forte, Forte Enterprise) sold as systems and as cloud access, plus quantum networking, sensing and security products

quarterly_data.quarter: IonQ press release: IonQ and the University of Cambridge Open the IonQ Quantum (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: IonQ and the University of Cambridge opened the IonQ Quantum Innovation Centre at the Cavendish Laboratory's Ray Dolby Centre, the next phase of the partnership announced on March 11, 2026 (the university's largest corporate research partnership), with nine inaugural research projects; IonQ will deploy a Superion 256-qubit quantum computer and an entanglement-distribution quantum network at the University - two Quantum Networking Data Centres and three Quantum Networking Nodes - plus access to IonQ quantum computers through the IonQ cloud.
quarterly_data.figure: 1 Superion 256 system; two Quantum Networking Data Centres and three Quantum Networking Nodes
